ROUTE_PUBLISHER_OR_ARCHIVE_EXACT_EDITION.purpose: Recover an authenticated complete pre-cutoff edition bound to the frozen DocumentVersion identity.
allowed_sources: web archive with immutable capture timestamp

query_templates.template: Publisher archive/history lookup for the frozen DocumentVersion and its recorded locator, bounded to the information cutoff.
Web-archive capture lookup for the exact source locator with capture timestamp not later than the information cutoff.

ROUTE_PUBLISHER_OR_ARCHIVE_EXACT_EDITION.evidence_contract: Preserve capture timestamp, locator, retrieved bytes, SHA-256, content type, redirect chain, and exact binding to the frozen DocumentVersion.
ROUTE_PUBLISHER_OR_ARCHIVE_EXACT_EDITION.success_contract: Complete edition bytes are authenticated at or before cutoff and match the frozen edition identity without rebinding.
ROUTE_PUBLISHER_OR_ARCHIVE_EXACT_EDITION.failure_contract: Retain NOT_PROVEN and every prior blocker; a current page, publication date, metadata, or late copy is insufficient.

ROUTE_AUTHENTICATED_FRAGMENT_WITNESS.purpose: Authenticate a frozen exact fragment without claiming the full historical edition.
allowed_sources: official preserved excerpt with immutable custody

query_templates.template: Exact-phrase archive lookup for the SHA-256-bound frozen fragment, bounded to the information cutoff.
Digest/capture verification for a preserved payload containing the exact frozen fragment.

ROUTE_AUTHENTICATED_FRAGMENT_WITNESS.evidence_contract: Record exact fragment bytes, fragment SHA-256, archive capture timestamp, payload digest, literal-match result, and source locator.
ROUTE_AUTHENTICATED_FRAGMENT_WITNESS.success_contract: The exact frozen fragment is literally present in an authenticated pre-cutoff payload; claim scope remains FRAGMENT only.
ROUTE_AUTHENTICATED_FRAGMENT_WITNESS.failure_contract: Retain NOT_PROVEN for that fragment and retain full-edition NOT_PROVEN in all cases.
forbidden_inferences: fragment witness authenticates the full edition
similar wording is an exact match

ROUTE_ACTOR_MANDATE_OR_REPRESENTATION.purpose: Establish whether an observed speaker or organization represents the exact frozen actor group for the issue and time at hand.

query_templates.template: Locate a source-bound formal mandate naming the representative, represented actor group, issue scope, and validity dates.
Locate an authenticated collective decision or procedure establishing representation of the exact frozen actor group.

ROUTE_ACTOR_MANDATE_OR_REPRESENTATION.evidence_contract: Bind the represented group, representative, authority source, issue scope, temporal scope, and any limits or revocation.
ROUTE_ACTOR_MANDATE_OR_REPRESENTATION.success_contract: Representation of the exact frozen actor group is explicit, source-bound, issue-specific, and valid for the relevant time.
ROUTE_ACTOR_MANDATE_OR_REPRESENTATION.failure_contract: Retain UNKNOWN_GROUP_REPRESENTATION; title, employment, participation, or affiliation alone is insufficient.
forbidden_inferences: organ represents aggregate authority group without mandate

ROUTE_REFERENCE_COMPONENT_COVERAGE.purpose: Test evidence coverage against every component of the unchanged frozen reference statement.
allowed_sources: explicit actor statement covering the composite reference

query_templates.template: Build a component-by-component coverage matrix against the unchanged frozen reference statement.
Locate explicit actor evidence addressing the complete composite reference, not a single component.

ROUTE_REFERENCE_COMPONENT_COVERAGE.evidence_contract: Preserve exact reference text and SHA-256; identify each component, supporting chain, uncovered component, and conflicting evidence.
ROUTE_REFERENCE_COMPONENT_COVERAGE.success_contract: Every essential reference component is explicitly covered for the same actor and time without rewriting or narrowing the reference.
ROUTE_REFERENCE_COMPONENT_COVERAGE.failure_contract: Retain UNKNOWN_FULL_REFERENCE_COVERAGE when any essential component remains uncovered or disputed.
forbidden_inferences: reference may be narrowed after evidence review
different actors or dates may be silently combined

ROUTE_TARGET_TIME_APPLICABILITY.purpose: Establish applicability at the frozen target time without automatic carry-forward.

query_templates.template: Locate an admissible observation at the frozen target time for the exact actor and reference.
Locate an explicit source-bound duration or reaffirmation covering the entire unobserved target interval.

ROUTE_TARGET_TIME_APPLICABILITY.evidence_contract: Record observation time, asserted duration, actor/reference identity, source edition status, and any superseding or contradictory statement.
ROUTE_TARGET_TIME_APPLICABILITY.success_contract: An admissible source directly covers target time or explicitly covers the full gap with no superseding evidence.
ROUTE_TARGET_TIME_APPLICABILITY.failure_contract: Retain UNKNOWN_NO_CARRY_FORWARD; the last earlier message is never carried forward automatically.

ROUTE_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTION_LANGUAGE.purpose: Recover enough context to identify speaker, attribution, modality, actor scope, reference scope, and original-language meaning.
allowed_sources: human-verified translation bound to original text

query_templates.template: Recover surrounding context establishing speaker, attribution, modality, date, and issue scope for the frozen fragment.
Recover original-language context and, when needed, a separately attested human translation bound to the original bytes.

ROUTE_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTION_LANGUAGE.evidence_contract: Preserve original bytes, language, speaker, quotation boundary, modality, surrounding context, translation author/status, and custody hashes.
ROUTE_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTION_LANGUAGE.success_contract: The exact fragment is attributable, context-complete for the proposed mapping, and linguistically interpretable without invented speaker or scope.
ROUTE_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTION_LANGUAGE.failure_contract: Retain the inherited BLOCKED or NOT_REVIEWED state; AI translation candidates are not HUMAN-certified.

ROUTE_COUNTEREVIDENCE_REVIEW.purpose: Review all preserved DISPUTED, unlinked, and possible counterevidence facts without deletion or convenient selection.

query_templates.template: Review every preserved unlinked fact against each affected CodingItem and record inclusion or exclusion with provenance.
Review every preserved DISPUTED fact and incompatible source chain without averaging or silent resolution.

ROUTE_COUNTEREVIDENCE_REVIEW.evidence_contract: Retain original fact status and IDs; record every linkage decision, exclusion reason, conflicting source, and search-limit statement.
ROUTE_COUNTEREVIDENCE_REVIEW.success_contract: All preserved counterevidence units are explicitly reviewed under frozen rules, and any direct resolution is source-bound and separately frozen.
ROUTE_COUNTEREVIDENCE_REVIEW.failure_contract: Retain DISPUTED, unlinked, and completeness-UNKNOWN states; absence of a found source is not proof of absence.
forbidden_inferences: conflicts may be averaged or silently selected
